from math import gcd
from functools import reduce

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    rr=[]; cc=[]
    for r in range(h):
        vals=[c for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==8]
        if vals:
            s=sorted(vals); st=pr=s[0]
            for x in s[1:]:
                if x!=pr+1: rr.append(pr-st+1); st=x
                pr=x
            rr.append(pr-st+1)
    for c in range(w):
        vals=[r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c]==8]
        if vals:
            s=sorted(vals); st=pr=s[0]
            for x in s[1:]:
                if x!=pr+1: cc.append(pr-st+1); st=x
                pr=x
            cc.append(pr-st+1)
    scale=reduce(gcd,rr+cc)
    cells=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0,8)]
    minr=min(r for r,c,v in cells); maxr=max(r for r,c,v in cells)
    minc=min(c for r,c,v in cells); maxc=max(c for r,c,v in cells)
    H=maxr-minr+1; W=maxc-minc+1
    # rotate marker bbox clockwise; align resulting bounding box to 8 tile bounding box
    objr=min(r for r in range(h) if any(grid[r][c]==8 for c in range(w)))
    objc=min(c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c]==8 for r in range(h)))
    colorpos={}
    for r,c,v in cells:
        nr=c-minc
        nc=maxr-r
        colorpos[(objr//scale+nr, objc//scale+nc)]=v
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c]==8:
                key=(r//scale,c//scale)
                if key in colorpos: out[r][c]=colorpos[key]
    return out
